title: The Greater Cord Canon
summary: A canon of heavy ropes of qi that pin a strong foe and turn a thrown spear back along its own line.

title: A Treatise on Tethering Many at Once
summary: A treatise on spreading one anchor into many threads that hold a dozen foes or steady a whole group of allies.

title: The Binding Beyond the Body
summary: Teaches how to bind through the living qi field so that a foe is held at range with no visible cord to cut.

title: Manual of the Paired Tether
summary: A manual of tethers cast in twos so that what one end does the other end answers.

title: The Hawk's Talon Tether Manual
summary: A manual of the tether thrown like a hawk's claw that seizes a foe from above and lifts the foe clear.

title: The Basin and River Binding
summary: A text on binding qi gathered in a basin and loosed as a river that ties each foe it passes.

title: The Wind-Sworn Binder's Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the wind-sworn binder who sets a bearing and ties cords to the gust itself.

title: Canon of the Oath Held Fast
summary: A canon on the binding that rests on a spoken oath and tightens on the one who steps against it.

title: The Plateau Bearing of the Long Tether
summary: A Xiantian manual of the bearing that anchors the user and lets one tether reach very far.
